extracted.intended_audience: researchers, data analysts, e-commerce trust and fraud analysts, policymakers
extracted.subtask_description: An annual sectoral barometer measuring e-commerce trust in France using an aggregation of verified consumer reviews and a weighted scoring model. The work analyzes review-derived trust signals across companies and time to produce structural findings about sectoral trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verified consumer reviews tied to transaction identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Each review is tied to a transaction identifier.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews are treated as "verified" by linking them to a transaction identifier to establish authenticity and transaction-level provenance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recency (weight dimension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recency is one of four dimensions used to weight each review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: More recent reviews receive different weights in the aggregated score to reflect temporal relevance; the page lists recency as an explicit weighting factor but does not provide the exact weighting formula.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical volume (weight dimension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical volume is one of four dimensions used to weight each review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weights account for the volume/statistical robustness of review evidence (e.g., higher volume provides stronger signal); the document notes statistical volume as a weighting criterion without specifying implementation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source verification (weight dimension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Source verification is one of four dimensions used to weight each review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews are evaluated by the extent to which their source can be verified; this factor adjusts a review's influence in the composite trust score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author profile coherence (weight dimension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Author profile coherence is one of four dimensions used to weight each review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A review's weight is affected by how coherent the author's profile is (consistency, plausibility of activity), reducing influence of anomalous or inconsistent reviewer profiles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aggregation scope and sample coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Analysis is based on 30,861 verified consumer reviews aggregated across 580,500 French companies between January 2024 and April 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample size, company coverage, and time window are explicit parts of the study's methodology and inform the representativeness and generalizability of findings.
